method.time_boundary: 主机命令时钟不与视频PTS直接相减；零请求间隔不等于同一触摸/即时返回；采样空档、录像时长均不等于动画时长。

limits: Host command timings are not synchronized to video PTS and are not device event timestamps.
Recording duration, sample gaps and nominal FPS are not animation duration, jank or refresh-rate proof.
Dark media pixels are not necessarily outside the media container; nonblack spans/envelopes remain pixel evidence only.
A rejected template position stays a candidate; it does not prove a continuous trajectory.
